summary.text: SPORTSHUNDER AS is a private limited company registered in Trondheim, founded 2010-11-18. SPORTSHUNDER AS is registered for all types of animal-related business, mainly within teaching and lecturing, as well as the sale of animal-related products. Its main industry code is 96.990: other personal service activities n.e.c.. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 1 745 475 NOK and the annual result was 147 846 NOK; operating income was up from 1 648 992 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -108 873 NOK in 2024 to 147 846 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 80 744 NOK in 2024 to 228 590 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Eirin Dahl (daglig leder and styrets leder). Its verified website is sportshunder.no, which links to its Facebook, Instagram profiles. The registered employee count went from 10 on 2026-01-14 to 8 on 2026-07-16. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-16 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
